reply_text:
㊥ ("maybe I overwrote your changes?") You did not overwrite it: the fix is in the file the site serves, and a fresh browser shows the whole figure. Your browser is most likely still using its cached copy of the old `harness.html`. The notebook is republished.

㊬ ("The published figure is still not full-size for me")
- **Git:** my commit `9d3762c` is under your `c76ffda` on `origin/master`.
- **Live file:** `https://hyperreal.enterprises/harness.html` contains the new sizing rule and was last modified at 19:12 UTC.
- **Fresh browser:** a headless Chromium screenshot of the live About page at 1600 px wide shows the whole figure, all six columns, the lower band and the purple boundary.

🈖 (why you still see the old one) The server sends no cache instruction for `harness.html`, so a browser that loaded the old version keeps reusing it for a few hours without asking again. Reloading the About page does not always reload the page inside the frame.

🈸 (two ways to clear it)
1. **For you, now:** a hard reload of the About page (Ctrl+Shift+R), or open `harness.html` directly and reload it.
2. **For everyone:** I added a version to the frame's address (`harness.html?v=20261004`) so every browser fetches the current file. It is committed on futon7a `master` as `ec6ca12` and not pushed; `git push origin master` publishes it.

If the figure is still cut off after a hard reload, tell me your browser and window width and I will look again.

㊢ ("Yes you can republish the notebook") Done. I rendered the notebook at HEAD (`d2b8acfa`) and copied it to the wip site.
- **Checked before copying:** no evaluation errors, no home-directory path, 6 links, the new opening and the census paragraph present.
- **Checked after:** the page served at `https://zone.hyperreal.enterprises/wip/notebooks/daxiang_live.html` is byte-identical to the render, last modified 19:16 UTC.
- **Backup:** this morning's copy is at `/tmp/c2-daxiang_live-live-before-0445.html`.

㊢ ("Naming as Joe is fine") The notebook keeps "(Joe)" in the setting sentence, your name on the author line, and the section 8 log line as logged. No change was needed.
